name: Shenzhen Jufei Optoelectronics Co., Ltd.
summary: Shenzhen Jufei Optoelectronics Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the research, development, production, and sale of SMD LED devices in China, Japan, South Korea, Taiwan, Vietnam, Mexico, Indonesia, Turkey, India, and internationally. The company offers backlight LED products, backlight LED modules, lighting LEDs, lighting LED modules, automotive LEDs, opto semiconductors, TO-CAN products for transmitting and receiving, optical films, and invisible light products. Its products are used in various applications, such as mobile phones, tablets (PADs), computers, TVs, electrical appliances, displays, lighting, automotive electronics, optical communication, and optical sensing.…
